conflicts.axis: Relocation Scope Definition (Semantic vs. Literal Line Range)

reviews.why: Atom 'atom_001' defines the relocation scope for the 'DONE-admission action-evidence guard' as 'only the DONE-admission action-evidence guard' (specifically referencing ~85:67-84). However, atom 'atom_010' from a different proposal defines the scope for the same 'action-evidence DONE-guard block' as 'lines 12-95' from the same file (driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1). These two definitions are mutually exclusive and represent a fundamental disagreement on the exact code block to be relocated, leading to an ambiguous and conflicting implementation plan.
reviews.fix: The proposals (A, B, C) must reconcile their understanding of what constitutes the 'DONE-admission action-evidence guard'. A single, precise definition of the code block (either by line numbers or clear semantic boundaries) must be agreed upon, and the conflicting atoms ('atom_001' and 'atom_010') must be updated to reflect this consensus.
